location: Mount Gambier, Limestone Coast, SA, Australia

main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Situated at Glenburnie on South Australia's Limestone Coast. An undulating 1,850m turf oval with a 300m home straight. Features continuous gentle undulations through the back stretch. Tactical early speed ('P') and on-pace runners ('E') holding position into the 300m straight carry a distinct mathematical advantage.
main_turf.post_bias: Inside barriers (stalls 1–4) in 900m, 1200m, and 1400m races hold a solid advantage to secure early rail position and save ground on the turns. Outer draws (8+) face energy loss on undulating bends.

handicapping_angles.victorian_border_shippers: Mount Gambier is situated near the Victorian border and receives high-volume shippers from Warrnambool, Hamilton, Casterton, Geelong, and Ballarat (e.g. Symon Wilde, Lindsey Smith, Tom Dabernig, Paul Preusker). Upgrade Victorian shippers dropping into SA country ranks (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.limestone_coast_wet_track_mudlarks: Mount Gambier receives high winter rainfall. On Soft 7 to Heavy 10 tracks, the track turns into a demanding test of stamina. Heavily upgrade proven wet-trackers ('Mudlarks') with 2+ wins on Heavy ground.
handicapping_angles.mount_gambier_cup_carnival: During the Mount Gambier Cup ($70k+) feature meeting in March/April, race quality elevates to SA Provincial level. Factor in higher class offsets for Cup day feature races.
